name: Brother Tormund
personality: Speaks in parables. Always keeps his hands visible and open.
ideals: Redemption — every soul deserves a second chance.
bonds: Searching for the relic that can heal his mentor's cursed wound.
flaws: Refuses to let anyone die on his watch, even at his own peril.
backstory: Former soldier who found faith after surviving a massacre he caused.
goals: Find the Relic of St. Avras
notes: Has a scar across his right cheek. Hums battle hymns when nervous.
